newsitem.title: CANADA: Placer says mines unaffected by PNG unrest.
newsitem.headline: Placer says mines unaffected by PNG unrest.

text.p: Canada's Placer Dome Inc said Wednesday that its two gold mining operations in Papua New Guinea were not affected by unrest there.
Placer owns half of the Porgera mine and 80 percent of the Misima mine in the South Pacific country.
The country's prime minister, Sir Julius Chan, stepped down after widespread protests and fighting on the island of Bougainville.
A Placer spokesman said the company's mines and shipping operations were outside the area of unrest. "There have been no repurcussions in the areas where we operate," he said.
Placer's small expatriate staff in the capital Port Moresby were "not unduly concerned" by recent developments and have decided to remain in place, he said.
